title: November Retreat — Schedule
body:
Here is the schedule for our November 20–22 retreat. Please note that we will finish on Sunday at 8:30 a.m., rather than noon as originally announced.

FRIDAY & SATURDAY
6:30–7:00 Coffee
7:00–9:00 Sitting (3 periods)
9:00–10:00 Breakfast
10:00–11:30 Manual work
12:00–1:00 Sitting & Dharma talk
1:00–2:00 Lunch
2:00–3:00 Rest
3:00–5:00 Sitting
5:00–6:00 Dinner
6:30–8:30 Sitting
9:30 Lights out

SUNDAY
6:30–7:00 Coffee
7:00–7:50 Sitting
8:00–8:30 Concluding remarks
8:30 Retreat ends

We hope you can join us for all or part of the retreat!
